messages:
deploy-bot: COMPLETE: rollout v2024.3 -> eu-west-1 finished. starting post-deploy smoke checks (kv-probe, embed-synth, latency). logs: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1742345678

alice (release): seeing 5/20 embed synth failures already, p95 503 on embed endpoint. anyone else? :thinking:

ben (sre): yep, seeing intermittent 503s to /v1/embeddings at 12:03:27-12:03:45 UTC. error rate ~25% in the canary pool. tailing logs now.

kevin (devops): curious if it's LB routing to a model variant with different warmup. quick curl reproducer:

```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"test"}'
# => HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
```

ben (sre): log excerpt from embed-runtime (container id abc123):

```
[12:03:27] ERROR upstream_read_timeout: read timeout from model-backend id=model-variant-b
[12:03:29] WARN retrying request, attempt=1
[12:03:31] ERROR upstream_read_timeout: read timeout from model-backend id=model-variant-b
[12:03:33] INFO fallback to model-variant-a
```

carmen (release-manager): hmm. two options: pin eu-west to v2024.2 (safe rollback) or rollforward with mitigations (increase upstream timeout + retry). thoughts? We should decide within 10m to avoid global promotion.

alice (release): i'd prefer pin/rollback until we root cause. mitigations might mask problem and cause wider impact. +1 to rollback for eu-west.

ben (sre): agree with rollback for the canary slice. we still want to capture diagnostics: I'll snapshot model-variant-b JVM heap, core dump if seen, and capture LB access logs. If rollback approved, do it on the canary slice only, not full region.

kevin (devops): deploy-bot can pin traffic back to v2024.2 for canary slice. command: `deployctl pin --region eu-west-1 --service embeddings --version v2024.2 --scope canary`

carmen (release-manager): executing pin now and opening incident ticket PRD-3445. tagging eng-ml-oncall and ben.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin applied to embeddings in eu-west-1 (scope=canary, version=v2024.2). rolling traffic for pinned slice. ETA ~45s.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: pin/rollforward applied. canary slice restored to v2024.2. observed error rate in pinned slice dropped to ~0% in next 60s.

ben (sre): confirmed error rate drop in pinned slice. remaining failures were from non-pinned hosts hitting variant-b; i'll scrub those hosts and cordon them from traffic until root cause determined. collecting traces for a postmortem.

alice (release): decision: rollback/pin canary. we'll postpone global promotion and update release notes: "Hold: v2024.3 promotion in eu-west due to embed 503s; canary pinned to v2024.2; investigations ongoing." Change window follow-up scheduled: 2024-06-18 03:00 UTC for attempted re-rollout after remediation.

carmen (release-manager): creating postmortem ticket and assigning eng-ml-oncall + ben. also adding a follow-up task to add a synthetic warmup probe that hits model-variant-b pre-promotion.

eng-ml-oncall: ack. i'll prioritize model-variant-b startup profile, add kv warmup, and run a private smoke against variant-b tomorrow during low traffic.

alice (release): thanks all. i'll update the release notes and notify customers in the maintenance channel. :white_check_mark:
